create.name: Ranjit Deora
create.bio:
Ranjit Deora, known to his students as Guru Ranjit, is a meditation teacher who founded Charlotte Meditation, a studio in Charlotte, North Carolina. He grew up in Udaipur in India, where his mother, a daily practitioner, gave him his first lessons in meditation. As a young man he travelled through India and Nepal, spending time at Buddhist monasteries and sacred places to absorb their silence, and he later trained in Zero Point Meditation under Dhirendra Brahmachari. He has been guiding students for more than thirty years.

In his teaching, meditation is a return to a quiet that is already present rather than an effort to stop thinking, and he favours awareness over striving. Most of his work is one-to-one: personal sessions in the Charlotte studio or online that combine conversation, breathing and emotional awareness. He also trains new mindfulness teachers over ten weeks, leads laughter yoga for groups and workplaces, and has run programmes for companies and universities. With senior instructor Angela Gala he co-founded Youth Meditation, a non-profit that brings mindfulness into schools and families around Charlotte.

courses.title: Mindfulness Meditation: 8-week private programme
courses.description: Eight weekly one-to-one hours with him, in the Charlotte studio or online, learning breathing, awareness of emotional patterns and a daily practice of stillness. Single follow-up sessions are $120 for those who have finished a programme.

courses.title: Mindfulness Meditation Teacher Training
courses.description: A ten-week certification taught one to one in weekly hour-long sessions, mainly in the Charlotte studio with an online option. Trainees deepen their own practice, learn to guide breathing and awareness sessions, and co-teach and observe classes with the studio's team.

courses.title: Laughter Yoga sessions
courses.description: Group sessions of guided laughter exercises, deep breathing and light movement for teams and community groups, with longer formats that add breathwork and an introduction to mindfulness meditation.
